title: unifig configuration
description:
Declarative configuration for a UniFi Network application (the Controller). Point your editor at this schema from the top of unifig.yaml:

  # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liambeeton/unifig/main/schema/unifig.schema.json

Any string value may contain ${ENV_VAR} references, which unifig replaces from the environment when it loads the file. Connection details (Controller host, API key) are not configured here — they live in the environment.

networks.title: Networks
networks.description: LAN networks and VLANs. Matched against the Controller by name; WAN slots are not networks and are configured separately.

wlans.title: WLANs
wlans.description: Wireless networks (SSIDs). Not reconciled yet — unifig validates this section but does not plan or apply it.

network.title: Network
network.description: A LAN network or VLAN on the Controller.

name.title: Name
name.description: The network's name, as shown in the Controller. This is its natural key: unifig matches on it, so renaming a network here means replacing it.

vlan.title: VLAN ID
vlan.description: 802.1Q VLAN ID. Omit for an untagged network such as the default LAN.

subnet.title: Subnet
subnet.description: The gateway address and prefix length in CIDR notation, e.g. 10.20.0.1/24 — the Controller's own convention, so the host part is the gateway rather than the network address.

wlan.title: WLAN
wlan.description: A wireless network (SSID) and the network its clients join.

name.title: SSID
name.description: The broadcast SSID. This is the WLAN's natural key.

network.title: Network
network.description: The name of the network this WLAN's clients join. Must be the name of a network defined in this file.
